verdict.rationale: Porkbun's first-party API docs state full create, read, update, and delete over DNS records across many types, including TXT. TXT CRUD is the mechanism ACME DNS-01 challenges need, and the docs also cover dynamic-DNS automation and a sandbox key for testing. Missing for 10: explicit ACME/DNS-01 challenge guidance in the docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the DNS API, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As a developer, DNS records are CRUD-able via a documented API — create, update, and delete records programmatically for automation and ACME challenges

citations.quote: Create, read, update, and delete DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA, TLSA, SSHFP, ALIAS, HTTPS, SVCB)
